findings.desc: Wrapper-root DONE can false-block before the wrapper-aware DONE oracle. transition-orchestrator resolves doneGitCwd for DONE and passes it to runDonePreMergeGate/buildDoneChecklist, where the new review-assurance-floor row calls evaluateReviewAssuranceFloor with gitCwd. But actor.can() runs first in transition-orchestrator, and machine.canFinishGuard/getGuardFailureReason call evaluateReviewAssuranceFloor with only projectRoot. In wrapper-root layouts where metadataRoot != gitRoot, evaluateReviewAssuranceFloor falls back to gitCwd=projectRoot, so git diff main...HEAD/currentMaterialHash run from the non-git metadata root and return floor.ok=false. Result: the machine can reject TEST→DONE before the DONE oracle row that has the resolved gitCwd can pass, breaking DONE oracle vs machine.canFinish consistency and wrapper-root behavior. Existing new smoke only exercises the evaluator directly and does not cover the actor guard path. Source refs: packages/main/src/handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts:343, packages/main/src/handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts:391, packages/main/src/core/machine.ts:431, packages/main/src/core/machine.ts:870, packages/main/src/core/review-assurance-floor.ts:258, packages/main/src/core/done-oracle.ts:745.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 3b6a2682b by threading resolved DONE gitCwd into machine canFinish actor context and resolving gitCwd inside getGuardFailureReason fallback; regression covered by review-assurance-floor smoke 'wrapper-root machine DONE guard uses resolved gitCwd'. Verified: npm run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-assurance-floor-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-escalation-smoke.js; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs; lattice validate --story=B-ed99.

findings.desc: Accepted Review Assurance Floor says high-risk lifecycle/gate/Authority/process-fact work keeps the stronger 3x2 or explicit degraded-single-host path (docs/requirements/decisions/review-assurance-floor-execution-plan.md:10,62,70,79), but evaluateReviewAssuranceFloor only chooses one-local-round vs three-local-rounds from failureSignals and never reads story riskSignals/priority/touchpoints (packages/main/src/core/review-assurance-floor.ts:324-329). Existing review escalation only requires 3x2 after the first REVIEW round has >=2 countable problems (packages/main/src/core/review-escalation.ts:225-229), so a high-risk gate/process-fact material code change with no failure signal can satisfy DONE with one local round. That undercuts the accepted concept rather than preserving the stronger-review boundary for high-risk local non-authority evidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 3b6a2682b by adding high-risk lifecycle/gate/Authority/process-fact review assurance floor semantics: 3 rounds x 2 independent local hosts, or explicit degraded-single-host fallback bound to current material; ordinary clean material code remains one local round and failure signals remain sticky 3x1 unless high-risk applies. Local evidence continues to report authorityDone=false, fullAuthorityDone=false, productionDone=false. Verified: npm run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-assurance-floor-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-escalation-smoke.js; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs; lattice validate --story=B-ed99.

findings.desc: Review assurance floor now consumes host_verdict evidence from autopilot_review_submit and review_escalation_fallback records, but the existing process fact entries still state these facts are consumed only by the review escalation DONE gate. That conflicts with the story decision/process-fact contract: gate-consumed evidence for the new review_assurance_floor DONE predicate must be mechanically registered and must not leave stale "only review escalation" semantics in PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS / PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY verification. Update the autopilot_review_submit and review_escalation_fallback_set process-fact rationale/gateConsumer/contract checks to include the review assurance floor consumer, while preserving the no-Authority-overclaim boundary.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by registering autopilot_review_submit host-verdict evidence and review_escalation_fallback_set degraded fallback evidence as consumed by both storyMachine.canFinish DONE review escalation gate and storyMachine.canFinish DONE review assurance floor gate in PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS plus process-events artifact registry, with COMMAND_POLICIES and verify-process-fact-contract assertions updated to require both consumers while preserving Authority receipt/authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/productionDone no-overclaim language. Verified: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs; node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-assurance-floor-smoke.js; lattice validate --story=B-ed99 --json after verification evidence refresh.

findings.desc: Process-fact registration is incomplete for the new review assurance floor DONE consumer. The new evaluator consumes host_verdict evidence from autopilot_review_submit and degraded fallback evidence from review_escalation_fallback_set, but those command facts still declare only the review escalation DONE gate as their consumer: process-fact-levels.ts records autopilot_review_submit and review_escalation_fallback_set as consumed by storyMachine.canFinish DONE review escalation gate, and process-fact-registry.ts sets the same single consumerGate for both artifacts. The contract verifier also only asserts /review escalation/ for autopilot_review_submit and does not require either evidence-producing command to name the review assurance floor consumer, so node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs can pass while the registry remains stale. This violates the repo process-fact contract for gate-consumed evidence and can mislead audit/doctor consumers about which gates consume local host verdict and fallback evidence. Source refs: packages/main/src/core/process-fact-levels.ts:138, packages/main/src/core/process-fact-levels.ts:162, packages/main/src/core/process-fact-registry.ts:417, packages/main/src/core/process-fact-registry.ts:424, scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:2023, scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:2051.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed the incomplete process-fact registration by making autopilot_review_submit and review_escalation_fallback_set mechanically name both DONE consumers: the existing local review escalation DONE gate and the new review assurance floor DONE gate. The contract verifier now requires both consumers for policy reasons, PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS gateConsumer entries, and PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY consumerGate entries, while retaining local Non-authority wording and checks that these commands do not claim Authority receipt completion, authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, or productionDone. Verified: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs; node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-assurance-floor-smoke.js; lattice validate --story=B-ed99 --json after verification evidence refresh.
